entities.summary: Abhilasha Kumari served as Judicial Member of Lokpal of India from 23 March 2019 to 26 March 2024. She is a former judge who served on the High Court of Gujarat from 2006 to 2018, and as the first female Chief Justice on the Manipur High Court in 2018. She was the chairperson of the Human Rights Commission of the Gujarat state of India from 17 May 2018 to 23 March 2019.
